localtime.reason: write_to_error_file calls time then localtime to format a civil-time prefix, and already substitutes <TIME UNAVAILABLE> when the converter returns NULL. The combined map resolves localtime from libc_a-lcltime.o. This is not the monotonic EE timer.

main_menu_active.reason: main_menu_unload, main_change_map_name, and main_load_ui_scenario write the CE we_are_at_the_main_menu flag. A generated empty body leaves spawn and unplug policy on a stale false.

main_menu_is_active.reason: input_abstraction_update, player queue errors, and local spawn read the same flag. A generated false changes controller-unplug handling and player lifecycle.

main_screen_shell_begin_fade.owner: HCU PS2 M1 sound-disabled menu music state
main_screen_shell_begin_fade.reason: The only rooted caller is main_change_map_name, and it calls begin_fade only when ui_main_menu_music_active() is TRUE. That query is already the false M1 adapter, so the fade and widget-stack dispose never run.

main_screen_shell_load.owner: HCU PS2 main-menu shell first-load adapter
main_screen_shell_load.reason: main_menu_load always calls this. CE's first-load path resets the controller-detection timer; Bink intro and widget-root load are excluded. The adapter keeps that timer reset and does not claim a loaded widget or intro.

memcpy.reason: The combined map resolves memcpy from libc_a-memcpy.o. Newlib documents overlap as undefined, matching the C contract Xbox CRT memcpy uses. csmemcpy asserts non-overlap before the call; remaining rooted sections are that wrapper or implicit struct copies.

menu_tags_loaded.owner: HCU PS2 excluded PC-menu tag injection
menu_tags_loaded.reason: scenario_tags_load calls this after tag instances are registered. The Linux body allocates widget/string/bitmap tags. Xbox CE does not. An empty load leaves the stock table and creates nothing for unload to free.

menu_tags_unloaded.owner: HCU PS2 excluded PC-menu tag injection
menu_tags_unloaded.reason: scenario_tags_unload calls this after texture-cache close. The pair with menu_tags_loaded is empty-on-empty, so no synthesized tag pointers survive the map.

mods_enable.reason: The HaloScript evaluator calls this. With no provider and no tags applied, enable cannot replace or restore map resources. The void command does not report a successful apply.

mods_list.reason: The HaloScript evaluator calls this. Printing 'none in the mods folder' would invent a successful scan. The adapter logs that no discovery provider exists.

mods_reload.reason: The HaloScript evaluator calls this. Linux rescans and replaces loaded resources. With no provider, reload must not mutate bitmap, sound, model, or string caches.

mods_tags_loaded.reason: scenario_tags_load calls this for UI and ordinary maps. Linux applies replacement assets. The adapter leaves CE tag bytes unchanged so unload has nothing to restore.

mods_tags_unloaded.reason: scenario_tags_unload calls this after sound and texture cache close. Because load never applied replacements, unload does not restore or free cache pointers.

network_distributed_new_game.reason: game_initialize_for_new_map always calls this. Linux clears port-only tables and update_queues_distributed_reset. Local update_server_next_update still consumes those latch bits, so the reset is the minimum selected-source contract.

network_distributed_player_killed.reason: game_engine_player_killed calls this before local death, score, and respawn mutation. Linux rewrites killer identity only for a client or server. The local adapter leaves the caller's pointers unchanged.

network_distributed_player_picked_up.reason: players.c calls this through player_network_picked_up only when local_player_index is NONE, and Linux returns unless the connection is a server. Local inventory is already mutated beside the hook.

network_distributed_tick.reason: game_time_update calls this after every simulated tick. Linux only sends or applies remote state when the connection is a client or server. Local time and tick count already advanced before the call.

network_game_abort.reason: game_engine_update_non_deterministic calls this on postgame B without a server check. CE sets client_started for the next client start-frame. A generated empty body drops that flag.

network_game_accept_remote_connections.reason: player_ui_fast_setup_network_server writes the accept flag before a server create that already fails. CE stores the boolean. A generated empty body drops that write.

network_game_client_end_frame.reason: main_loop calls this only when connection is above local. Generated FALSE would display a host-down error. CE's no-client branch resets to local, repairs queues, and returns TRUE.

network_game_client_request_immediate_st.reason: The HaloScript evaluator calls this. CE only requests a start-time change when a client object exists. With no client, the void command does not invent a started session.

network_game_client_start_frame.reason: main_loop calls this only for a network client or server. Generated FALSE would abort. CE consumes client_started or, with no client, resets to local and returns TRUE.

network_game_distributed_client.reason: Combat, shields, pickups, AI placement, and game-mode rules branch on this predicate. CE is game_connection() == _game_connection_network_client. A generated constant false would hide a later client connection.

network_game_server_ban_player.reason: hs_compile_and_evaluate_command calls this. CE returns FALSE when it cannot name a machine. With no server, FALSE is a failed command, not a successful ban.

network_game_server_get_game.reason: game_engine_player_killed reads the host record only when global_network_game_server_get() is non-NULL. That getter is already NULL. Returning NULL does not invent a host game.

network_game_server_kick_player.reason: hs_compile_and_evaluate_command calls this. CE returns FALSE when it cannot name a machine. With no server, FALSE is a failed command, not a successful kick.

network_game_server_matching_player_name.reason: console_complete asks for ban/kick names. CE returns 0 when no server exists. Zero matches is an empty completion, not a fabricated player list.

network_game_server_reset_to_pregame.reason: Postgame A calls this only when a server pointer exists. With a null server the call is skipped. FALSE is a failed host reset, not a successful return to pregame.

network_game_server_start_frame.reason: main_loop calls this only in the network-server branch. CE returns TRUE when no server object exists. Generated FALSE would mark the host down.

network_game_server_switch_to_postgame.reason: game_engine_update calls this only when a server pointer exists. Local postgame already ran. The adapter does not invent a host postgame record.

network_game_server_update_ticks.reason: game_time_update calls this only for a network-server connection. Local mode uses update_client_local_ticks. The adapter does not emit distributed tick messages.

network_votekick_matching_player_names.reason: console_complete asks for votekick names. CE returns 0 when votekick is unavailable. Zero matches is an empty completion, not a fabricated player list.
